description: Returns an MCP App card ranking Milwaukee restaurants with the most serious recent health-inspection violations. The server ranks a wide recent window and returns one page of that ranking. Supports limit/offset pagination.

limit.description: Maximum restaurants on this page of the ranking. Defaults to 10.

offset.description: Number of ranked restaurants to skip. Defaults to 0. pagination.next_offset in the result is the next page, or null when the ranking is finished.

name: get_milwaukee_inspections
